messages.author: 80ac11e65419558c
messages.subject: deployApp function hangs
parts:
Hi all,

Has anyone encountered the problem of getting stuck at "Uploading application bundle" when using the deployApp function?

I've built my app, tested it locally with runApp() and all is good, but when I use deployApp(), it's stuck at the line below.

deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://jrnew.shinyapps.io/FPETool? [Y/n] Y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...

When I left this running overnight, I received error 405 service timeout I think. Not sure even where to begin troubleshooting, so any insights would be appreciated!

Cheers,
JinRou

parts:
JinRou,

Any package that you would like to be deployed with your application should have an explicit library() somewhere in your ui.R or server.R (or other file in your application). I do not see shinyIncubator listed in the output for shinyapps::appDependencies(), so this leads me to believe that it was not loaded in your application with a library() call. You should double check that any package required by your application has an explicit library() somewhere in ui.R or server.R or another R file in your application.

Thanks
-Andy
